options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: batch_buffer
options.description: Maximum number of requests to buffer in memory.

options.name: batch_size
options.description: Number of requests in each PostgreSQL write transaction, as specified in the PostgreSQL configuration.

options.name: batch_workers
options.description: Number of Goroutines sending data to PostgreSQL, as specified in the PostgreSQL configuration. Set to current PostgreSQL pool size as default.

options.name: dsn
options.description: Attribute that specifies the data source names as a URL or PostgreSQL connection string. See the PostgreSQL docs for more information about connection strings.

options.name: enable_round_robin
options.description: Enables round robin scheduling on PostgreSQL. Any existing round robin scheduling will stop and migrate to PostgreSQL as entities check in with keepalives. Sensu will gradually delete the existing etcd scheduler state as keepalives on the etcd scheduler keys expire over time.

options.name: max_conn_lifetime
options.description: Maximum time a connection can persist before being destroyed.

options.name: max_idle_conns
options.description: Maximum number of number of idle connections to retain.

options.name: name
options.description: The Sensu resource's name. This name (in combination with the namespace where applicable) uniquely identifies the resource that Ansible operates on. If the resource with selected name already exists, Ansible module will update it to match the specification in the task. Consult the I(name) metadata attribute specification in the upstream docs on U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/) for more details about valid names and other restrictions.

options.name: pool_size
options.description: The maximum number of connections to hold in the PostgreSQL connection pool.

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Sensu object.

options.name: strict
options.description: When the PostgresConfig resource is created, configuration validation will include connecting to the PostgreSQL database and executing a query to confirm whether the connected user has permission to create database tables. Sensu-backend will try to connect to PostgreSQL indefinitely at 5-second intervals instead of reverting to etcd after 3 attempts. We recommend setting strict to true in most cases.
